description: Search the user's knowledge vault for notes matching a query. Returns notes ranked by relevance, each with its vault path, type/status/created provenance, and a matching snippet. A result the user engaged before also carries a quiet prior-engagement note; report it in plain language for the reader who asked, as for librarian-recent. Read-only; all query terms must match.

query.description: What to search for (free text; all terms must match).

type.description: Filter by frontmatter `type` (e.g. note, moc, reference).

name: librarian-search
title: Search the vault
